page.title: 前置詞は“感じた景色”で選ぶ

analysis.summaryJa: このページは前置詞を日本語訳の一対一対応で選ばず、話し手がどんな景色・焦点を感じているかで選ぶ考え方を扱う。aboutの「中心の周り」から、幅広い話題、概数、直前の未来へ広がる意味と、専門的に焦点を当てるon、核心を避けるaroundを対比する。
grammarPoints: aboutは中心の周辺から一般話題と概数へ広がる
be about toは動作直前を示す
onは専門的・直接的な主題を示す
talk aroundは核心を避けて周辺を話す
visualEvidence: 中心点の周囲を回る図がaboutの核を示す
数値の周りに幅を持たせた帯が概数を表す
動作直前の人物と矢印がabout toを示す
aboutとonの話題焦点の広さが大小の円で対比される
commonTraps: aboutとonを常に交換可能と考える
about toの後ろに動名詞を置く
talk aroundを単なるtalk aboutと同じにする
aboutの概数用法を正確値と誤解する

questions.prompt: The guide spoke ------- the museum's history during the bus ride.
questions.translationJa: ガイドはバス移動中、博物館の歴史について話しました。
questions.explanationJa: 一般的・幅広い話題を示すためaboutが自然です。

questions.prompt: The engineering director gave a technical lecture ------- battery safety standards.
questions.translationJa: 技術部長は電池安全基準に関する専門講演を行いました。
questions.explanationJa: lecture onは専門的で焦点の定まったテーマを示します。

questions.prompt: The train is ------- depart, so please board immediately.
questions.translationJa: 列車はまもなく出発します。すぐにご乗車ください。
questions.explanationJa: be about to＋動詞原形で「まさに～しようとしている」です。

questions.prompt: The estimated repair will cost ------- 800 dollars.
questions.translationJa: 修理費は約800ドルになる見込みです。
questions.explanationJa: 数値の周辺という中心イメージからaboutは「約」を表します。

questions.prompt: The spokesperson avoided the question and talked ------- the main issue.
questions.translationJa: 広報担当者は質問を避け、核心を遠回しに話しました。
questions.explanationJa: talk aroundは核心に直接触れず周囲を話す意味です。

questions.prompt: We need a short report ------- how customers use the new kiosk.
questions.translationJa: 新しい端末の顧客利用方法に関する短い報告書が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: report onは対象を直接分析する正式な話題指定です。

questions.prompt: There were ------- thirty attendees at the regional workshop.
questions.translationJa: 地域研修会には約30人が参加しました。
questions.explanationJa: 厳密でない人数を示す概数にはaboutを使います。

questions.prompt: The manager is ------- announce the revised schedule.
questions.translationJa: マネージャーはまさに改訂日程を発表しようとしています。
questions.explanationJa: is about to announceで直前の未来を表します。

questions.prompt: We chatted ------- local restaurants while waiting for the client.
questions.translationJa: 顧客を待つ間、地元のレストランについて雑談しました。
questions.explanationJa: chatのような日常的な話題にはaboutが自然です。

questions.prompt: The consultant published a detailed paper ------- supply-chain resilience.
questions.translationJa: コンサルタントはサプライチェーン強靭化に関する詳細な論文を発表しました。
questions.explanationJa: paper onは専門的に対象へ焦点を当てる組み合わせです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence about a general conversation topic.

choices.A: We talked on to the upcoming office move.
choices.B: We talked about the upcoming office move.
choices.C: We talked about to move the office topic.
choices.D: We talked into the upcoming office move.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは今後のオフィス移転について話しました。
questions.explanationJa: 一般的な会話の話題なのでtalk aboutが自然です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence announcing an immediate action.

choices.B: The webinar is on to beginning.
choices.C: The webinar is about to begin.

questions.translationJa: ウェビナーはまもなく始まります。
questions.explanationJa: be about toの後ろには動詞原形beginを置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence giving an approximate distance.

choices.A: The warehouse is on five kilometers away.
choices.B: The warehouse is about to five kilometers away.
choices.C: The warehouse is into five kilometers away.
choices.D: The warehouse is about five kilometers away.

questions.translationJa: 倉庫は約5キロ先です。
questions.explanationJa: about＋数量で概数を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence describing a specialist presentation.

choices.A: Dr. Rao delivered a presentation on data privacy.
choices.B: Dr. Rao delivered a presentation about to data privacy.
choices.C: Dr. Rao delivered a presentation around to data privacy.
choices.D: Dr. Rao delivered a presentation into data privacy.

questions.translationJa: ラオ博士はデータプライバシーに関する専門発表を行いました。
questions.explanationJa: presentation onは焦点の明確な専門テーマを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence meaning that someone avoided the central point.

choices.A: The vendor kept talking on to the delay.
choices.B: The vendor kept talking around the delay.
choices.C: The vendor kept talking about to the delay.
choices.D: The vendor kept talking into the delay.

questions.translationJa: 業者は遅延の核心を避けて話し続けました。
questions.explanationJa: talk aroundは問題の核心を避けることです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence about an informal topic.

choices.A: We joked on the confusing sign formally.
choices.B: We joked about to the confusing sign.
choices.C: We joked into the confusing sign.
choices.D: We joked about the confusing sign.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは分かりにくい標識について冗談を言いました。
questions.explanationJa: joke aboutは日常的で広い話題指定です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence about an academic subject.

choices.A: The journal published a study about to employee retention.
choices.B: The journal published a study around employee retention indirectly.
choices.C: The journal published a study on employee retention.
choices.D: The journal published a study into on employee retention.

questions.translationJa: その学術誌は従業員定着率に関する研究を掲載しました。
questions.explanationJa: study onは研究対象への直接的な焦点を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence describing an action moments away.

choices.A: The doors are about to close.
choices.B: The doors are about closing to.
choices.D: The doors are on to close.

questions.translationJa: 扉はまもなく閉まります。
questions.explanationJa: are about to closeが直前の未来を正しく表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence giving an approximate time.

choices.A: The inspection took on two hours.
choices.B: The inspection took about two hours.
choices.C: The inspection took about to two hours.
choices.D: The inspection took into two hours.

questions.translationJa: 検査には約2時間かかりました。
questions.explanationJa: 所要時間の概数なのでaboutが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that directly names a formal report topic.

choices.A: The committee issued a report about to workplace safety.
choices.B: The committee issued a report around workplace safety vaguely.
choices.C: The committee issued a report on workplace safety.
choices.D: The committee issued a report into workplace safety on.

questions.translationJa: 委員会は職場安全に関する報告書を発行しました。
questions.explanationJa: formalなreportの焦点を示すonが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We spoke about the new service."

choices.A: We were moments away from serving.
choices.B: We avoided mentioning the service entirely.
choices.C: The new service was the general topic of our conversation.
choices.D: We stood physically around the service.

questions.translationJa: 新サービスが私たちの会話の一般的な話題でした。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The meeting is about to start."

choices.A: The meeting concerns its own start.
choices.B: The meeting started a long time ago.
choices.C: The meeting is approximately a start.
choices.D: The meeting will start very soon.

questions.translationJa: 会議はまもなく始まります。
questions.explanationJa: be about toは動作が目前であることを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "About 200 orders were shipped."

choices.C: The orders were shipped around a building.

questions.translationJa: 約200件の注文が出荷されました。
questions.explanationJa: 数量前のaboutはapproximatelyと同義です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The professor lectured on logistics."

choices.A: The professor was about to move supplies.
choices.B: Logistics was the focused subject of the lecture.
choices.D: The professor stood on shipping boxes.

questions.translationJa: 物流が講義の専門的な主題でした。
questions.explanationJa: lecture onは専門的に焦点を当てる意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "He talked around the pricing problem."

choices.A: He solved the pricing problem immediately.
choices.C: He discussed related matters without addressing the pricing problem directly.
choices.D: He was about to stop speaking.

questions.translationJa: 彼は価格問題を直接扱わず周辺事項を話しました。
questions.explanationJa: talk aroundは核心を避けることです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The tour lasts about an hour."

choices.A: The tour lasts approximately one hour.
choices.B: The tour lasts exactly one hour by contract.

questions.translationJa: ツアーは約1時間です。
questions.explanationJa: about an hourは概算の時間です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "A documentary on robotics will air tonight."

choices.A: The documentary is about to become a robot.
choices.C: The documentary is placed on a robot.
choices.D: Tonight's documentary focuses specifically on robotics.

questions.translationJa: 今夜のドキュメンタリーはロボット工学に焦点を当てます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The plane is about to land."

choices.B: The plane will land in a moment.
choices.D: The plane is circling the topic of landing.

questions.translationJa: 飛行機はまもなく着陸します。
questions.explanationJa: about to landは着陸が目前である意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We chatted about the neighborhood."

choices.A: We delivered a formal technical paper.
choices.C: We had an informal conversation concerning the neighborhood.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは近所について気軽に話しました。
questions.explanationJa: chat aboutは日常的な話題について話すことです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The article is on tax reform."

choices.A: Tax reform is the article's specific subject.
choices.B: The article is physically above a tax form.
choices.C: The article is about to change taxes.
choices.D: The article gives only an approximate tax.

questions.translationJa: 税制改革がその記事の具体的な主題です。

questions.prompt: The client has arrived, and everyone is seated. The presentation is ------- begin.
questions.translationJa: 顧客が到着し全員着席しました。発表はまもなく始まります。
questions.explanationJa: 直前の状況なのでbe about to＋beginが適切です。

questions.prompt: The cafeteria renovation will cost somewhere between ¥4.8 and ¥5.2 million. The estimate is ------- ¥5 million.
questions.translationJa: 食堂改修費は480万～520万円の見込みです。概算は約500万円です。
questions.explanationJa: 幅のある見積額を丸めて示すためaboutです。

questions.prompt: This is a casual welcome dinner, not a formal seminar. We can talk ------- travel or local food.
questions.translationJa: これは正式なセミナーではなく歓迎夕食会です。旅行や地元料理について話せます。
questions.explanationJa: 気軽で幅広い会話の話題なのでaboutが自然です。

questions.prompt: The board needs precise findings, not a casual overview. Please prepare a report ------- the causes of the defect.
questions.translationJa: 取締役会は概説でなく正確な調査結果を求めています。不具合原因の報告書を作成してください。
questions.explanationJa: 正式で焦点の定まった調査対象にはreport onです。

questions.prompt: The interviewer asked why deliveries were late, but the carrier kept talking ------- the issue.
questions.translationJa: 面接担当者が配送遅延の理由を尋ねましたが、運送会社は核心を避け続けました。
questions.explanationJa: 直接答えず周辺を話すのでtalking aroundが適切です。

questions.prompt: The boarding announcement has finished and the doors are closing. Flight 208 is ------- depart.
questions.translationJa: 搭乗案内が終わり扉が閉まっています。208便はまもなく出発します。
questions.explanationJa: 出発直前なのでis about to departを用います。

questions.prompt: Attendance varies each week, but usually ------- fifty employees join the session.
questions.translationJa: 参加者は週ごとに変わりますが通常約50人が参加します。
questions.explanationJa: 変動する人数の概数を示すためaboutを選びます。

questions.prompt: The speaker is a cybersecurity researcher and will give a specialized talk ------- phishing prevention.
questions.translationJa: 講演者はサイバーセキュリティ研究者で、フィッシング防止の専門講演を行います。
questions.explanationJa: 専門的な焦点を表すtalk onが文脈に合います。

questions.prompt: The customer only asked for a friendly explanation. Please speak ------- the warranty in simple terms.
questions.translationJa: 顧客は分かりやすい説明だけを求めています。保証について平易に話してください。
questions.explanationJa: 一般向けの幅広い説明なのでspeak aboutが自然です。

questions.prompt: The auditor asked for the missing invoice date. Do not talk ------- it; answer with the exact date.
questions.translationJa: 監査人は不足している請求書の日付を尋ねました。遠回しにせず正確な日付を答えてください。
questions.explanationJa: 核心を避けることを禁止する文脈なのでtalk aroundです。
